data.one_liner: Flexible and high-performance AppBar behavior implementation.
data.what_it_does: Implements flexible appbar behaviors with nested scroll support, offering full control over scrolling, alignment, and animations compared to the standard Flutter AppBar.
use_when: You need advanced scroll-driven AppBar animations and behaviors.
You want to avoid gesture contention in nested scrolling environments.
avoid_when: You only need a standard, fixed Material Design appbar.
Your project does not use nested scrolling or custom appbar behaviors.
strengths: Supports multiple custom behaviors like MaterialAppBarBehavior and AbsoluteAppBarBehavior.
Provides detailed control over expansion, shrinking, and bouncing overscroll.
weaknesses: Requires explicit configuration and controller synchronization for complex layouts.
Niche package with potentially steep learning curve for custom scroll physics.
